summary: Repligen filed an 8-K updating its pending acquisition of BioLife Solutions under a July 21, 2026 merger agreement. BioLife holders would receive $11.25 cash plus 0.1442 Repligen shares per share. The registrant disclosed that the HSR waiting period expired at 11:59 p.m. Eastern on September 3, 2026, clearing the antitrust condition. Completion still requires BioLife stockholder adoption of the merger agreement; the special meeting is scheduled remotely for October 5, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern. Watch closing conditions and the shareholder vote as the remaining risk-arb catalysts.
